01 / A day in the field

The day keeps
the sun's hours.

There is no typical day. But this is the rhythm most of them follow, and it is set by the light, not the clock.

In Kenya now EAT
Kenya runs on East Africa Time, UTC+3, all year.
Sunrise Sunset
  1. 05:30 Now

    Tea

    Brought to the tent, before first light.

  2. 06:00 Now

    Out for the dawn light

    On the move by six, while the animals are too.

  3. 10:00 Now

    Breakfast in the bush

    Laid out wherever the morning ended up.

  4. 12:00 Now

    Rest at camp

    Through the midday heat. Read, sleep, do nothing.

  5. 15:30 Now

    Out again

    Back out as the heat breaks, until sunset.

  6. ≈ 18:40 Now

    Sunset

    So close to the equator, it comes at almost the same time all year.

  7. 20:00 Now

    Dinner under the stars

    And tomorrow's plan, adjusted to what today showed us.

With childrenWe slow the pace, cut the driving hours, and lean into walks, camp projects and astronomy after dark. The trip becomes calmer, not less interesting.

Times are East Africa Time · We adjust everything daily
